subjects.description: A black metallic robotic arm with a claw-like multi-finger gripper, suspended from above the cutting board

subjects.appearance_details: Rectangular plastic toy slab styled as salmon sashimi, with painted lighter pink striations across a deeper orange-pink base
subjects.relationship: Object being manipulated by the robotic arm
subjects.location: front-left area of the wooden cutting board
subjects.orientation: Lying flat on its broader side
subjects.action: being grasped, lifted slightly, moved right, and released into the orange bowl
subjects.state_changes: Lifted off the cutting board by the gripper, carried laterally toward the orange bowl, dropped into the bowl

background_setting: A wooden cutting board sits inside an open cardboard box on a workbench. Beyond the box, a tiled wall is visible in the upper portion of the frame, with a glimpse of a workshop setting and dark structural elements bordering the cardboard box on its sides.

lighting.shadows: Soft, short shadows beneath the toys and the bowl on the wooden cutting board
lighting.illumination_effect: Crisp, neutral exposure on the cutting board and its toy contents; the cardboard box sides and the tiled wall fall into modest shadow

aesthetics.composition: Three-quarter top-down medium shot with the cutting board angled within the cardboard box; the orange bowl sits center-right, the toy salmon front-left, the toy tomato front-right, and the toy carrot toward the front bottom
aesthetics.color_scheme: Warm wood tones of the cutting board, kraft brown of the cardboard box, vivid orange of the bowl and carrot, pinkish-orange of the salmon, deep red of the tomato, matte black of the robotic arm

cinematography.camera_angle: Three-quarter high angle, slightly forward of top-down
cinematography.focus: Cutting board and the toy food objects

context: Robotic pick-and-place demonstration using toy food objects on a wooden cutting board

actions.description: Robotic arm descends from above toward the toy salmon at the front-left of the cutting board
Gripper closes around the toy salmon, securing it
Arm lifts the toy salmon slightly off the cutting board and moves it rightward toward the orange bowl
Arm positions the toy salmon over the bowl and opens the gripper, releasing the salmon so it falls into the bowl
Arm retracts upward to a neutral position above the cutting board; the toy tomato and toy carrot remain untouched

segments.description: Continuous single-shot pick-and-place of the toy salmon into the orange bowl by the robotic arm
segments.key_changes: Toy salmon is grasped, lifted, moved right, released into the orange bowl; arm retracts
segments.camera: Static three-quarter top-down view, no camera motion

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the cutting board is shown inside the cardboard box with the toy salmon, bowl, tomato, and carrot in place, and the robotic arm hovering above. At 0:01 the arm descends toward the toy salmon at the front-left. At 0:02 the gripper closes around the toy salmon. At 0:03 the arm lifts the toy salmon slightly off the board. At 0:04 the arm moves the toy salmon right toward the orange bowl. At 0:05 the arm positions the toy salmon over the bowl. At 0:06 the gripper opens and the toy salmon falls into the bowl. At 0:07 the arm begins retracting upward. At 0:08 the arm has returned to a neutral position; the toy tomato and toy carrot remain untouched.
audio_description: Quiet workshop ambient room tone, faint mechanical whir and articulation sounds from the robotic arm during motion, a soft plastic contact sound when the toy salmon is dropped into the bowl; no speech or music.
